svg.title: The letters combined in (NF5) are the following actual terms. Besides the inherited activity logarithms, there are three finite local types: row-energy remainders indexed by a signed orientation and a row, a diagonal logarithmic correction indexed by a fine bond, and a Haar-chart correction indexed by an active fine bond. There are also five chain types: the principal log chains for the real plate with coefficient −1/2, the corresponding blank-plate chains with coefficient +1/2, the covariance correction chains with coefficient +1/2, the affine first-order correction, and the residual quadratic chain. Their chain lengths are their additional charges; the affine bond term has charge zero. Their supports are the corresponding full receipts enlarged by the halo parameter lB, including every lookup used by the term.
